pages.title: Inaccessible Cardinal
pages.text: An infinity so large no smaller infinity can build it, by unions or power sets. Its existence cannot be proved from the usual axioms. The token is heavy and remote, as if seen from a great distance. Nothing reaches it.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Using a topos, aleph-one and Hilbert's Hotel key in the Cantor Diagonalizer, I tried to build a larger infinity from smaller ones. It refused, and the result was an inaccessible cardinal.
Made in $(item)Cantor Diagonalizer$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Transfinite Hierarchy.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Infinity, Absolute Notes III.
